attribution: nflverse contributors, CC-BY-4.0 (players, rosters, stats, snap counts, combine); cited news pages
selection_rule: Every player with a regular-season NFL game (2012+ stats or snap counts), not on a 2026 roster or reserve list (nflverse roster_2026, fetched 2026-10-22; a CUT status counts as released), not retired in nflverse (players.csv status/ngs_status != RET), on a roster in 2024 or later and at most 34 (QB, K, P 40), Colin Kaepernick by name. The first 26 players are hand-checked for a 2025-26 retirement or signing and carry their news evidence; the rest (priority 27+, status_confidence 'nflverse', appearance_reviewed false) are the plausible pool sourced from nflverse alone and are re-verified for retirement, signing and appearance before they would ship. Known retired or signed and excluded: Bozeman, Morse, Dalman, D. Andrews, Seibert, R. Kelly, Clapp, R. Wilson, Scherff, L. Wilson, J. Simmons, D. Williams, N. Chubb, S. Hubbard, B. Huff; B. Aiyuk. Status rechecked 2026-10-23 against nflverse roster_2026 and players.csv (10/23), the NFL.com 2026 transaction ledger (reserve list, terminations, signings, waivers, trades, other), Pro Football Reference monthly 2026 transactions, and published 2025-26 retirement trackers; retired, under-contract and UFL-signed players were dropped and are listed in dropped_players.
rating_policy: nfl2k5_ratings_model (m2-ratings-3) per played season, last three played seasons blended by recency (2026/2025 1.0, 2024 0.6, 2023 0.3) x snaps/400 (0.15..1); then -1 speed/agility per year past 30 since the rated season, -2 speed/agility/stamina per full season out of the league (cap 12) and -1 per season on every skill (cap 8).
appearance_policy: Tail appearances are measured from each player's nflverse headshot (YuNet face box, ITA from cheek/forehead/nose patches; raw ITA kept in appearance_measure), then every headshot was visually reviewed against the six native tones because the 2026 nfl.com set is high-key and the ITA thresholds read dark faces as light. Skin 0..5 and the dreads bit ship the reviewed value, appearance_confidence is measured/reviewed/low, and low marks a correction two or more tones from the raw ITA or an obscured/non-nfl.com headshot. Body from height/weight BMI; face one of the seven native generic heads of that skin tone (build-dependent subset); dreads only where the headshot clearly shows hanging locs/braids (never on long straight hair, short twists or shaved heads; long locs tied up still get the bit so a dreads player never looks bald). The 26 hand-verified entries keep their reviewed skin/face/dreads and are untouched. No custom portraits are added: the dated free-agent no-photo selector stays.
commentary_policy: Verified generic surname clip when one exists, else the jersey number (never another player's full name).

status_refresh.method: roster_2026 and players.csv refreshed 2026-10-23; NFL.com 2026 reserve/retired and transaction pages; PFR monthly transactions; published retirement trackers. Every dropped player has a dated source in dropped_players.
